method: Tessl pillars (P1 systems invariants, P2 analytics, P3 risk ladder) applied to surviving attacks

redesigns.title: Replace BugBot substring matching with structured verdict
redesigns.invariant_statement: A vendor verdict is a structured field, not free-text. Free-text is never used to compute a verdict.
redesigns.blast_radius_control: substring kept as legacy_warning telemetry for 2 release cycles

redesigns.title: Separate detector-didnt-run from detector-ran-and-passed
redesigns.invariant_statement: The vacuous-test detector's absence is distinct from its absence-of-finding. Infra failure -> Red, not Green.

redesigns.title: Surface Skeptic::Warn text in to_json() telemetry
redesigns.invariant_statement: Every non-passing verdict carries its reason in operator-visible telemetry.
redesigns.blast_radius_control: purely additive; no production behavior change

redesigns.title: Tiered LOC floor keyed on file-class
redesigns.invariant_statement: The evidence floor is tiered by risk-class, not a single LOC threshold.

redesigns.title: Vendor identity is configuration + every reviewer has availability invariant
redesigns.invariant_statement: Vendor identity is configuration; every reviewer has an availability invariant.

redesigns.title: Invariant adherence dashboard (analytics meta-redesign)
redesigns.invariant_statement: Every invariant has a measurable adherence signal surfaced daily.
